name: – Anna Strolenberg – § 45 – § 32
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 45. Recalls that the EU has, first and foremost, a duty to protect the fundamental rights of the citizens of the Member States; recalls, in this regard, that the EU’s migration policies should be aimed primarily at establishing the effective protection of national borders and ensuring the safety of European societies;
